sources.description: COMAP 2027 MCM/ICM Instructions, sections III, IV, VI: English single-PDF submission, first-page Summary Sheet, 25 counted pages, anonymity and control-number headers, 25 MB size limit; actual problem-specific requirements remain unknown until the problem is published.
COMAP Contest AI Policy v102025, page 2: report on AI use in the same PDF after the solution, plus citations and accurate records; AI translation and code completion also require disclosure.
